EdwCustomTableConfig.CreateViewQuery:
CREATE VIEW [InternationalLogistics].[vw_GRP__ShipmentEntryNumbers] WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
SELECT JS, EntryNumbers = LEFT(STRING_AGG(CAST(EntryType + ' ' + EntryNum AS VARCHAR(MAX)), char(10)), 8000) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT JS = Parent.JS, E.EntryType, E.EntryNum FROM Customs.BAS__EntryNumber E JOIN InternationalLogistics.CUS__ShipmentParentIDs Parent ON Parent.ParentID = E.ParentID WHERE E.Category = 'CUS' AND E.ParentTable IN ('JobShipment', 'JobDeclaration', 'CusEntryHeader', 'CusMAWB') ) AS T GROUP BY JS
